snippet.title: Amnesia: Custom Stories "The Attic" by Everlost [Full Playthrough]
snippet.description:
Name: The Attic

Creator: Everlost

Download: https://www.moddb.com/mods/the-attic

----------------------

Get the Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/57300/Amnesia_The_Dark_Descent/

About this game: Amnesia: The Dark Descent puts you in the shoes of Daniel as he wakes up in a desolate castle, barely remembering anything about his past. Exploring the eerie pathways, you must also take part of Daniel's troubled memories. The horror does not only come from the outside, but from the inside as well. A disturbing odyssey into the dark corners of the human mind awaits.
